content: #1 I looked at thin homotopy and got a blank page. History only showed up a minor edit in 2016. I tried to edit the blank page and, of course, the source was correct for the 2016 page (so presumably it was a rendering problem). I made a very minor edit. Submitted that and the page was fine. I mention this since there may be other pages that are showing blank yet have the source code, so do not dispair if you see a blank page. Look at the source. ;-)
subject: seemingly blank page

content: #2 We have had this before. This is caused by accidentally missing line breaks in the code for the floating table of contents. (The old parser digested this, the new parser is more picky.) Fixed now.
